title: Here is why Supreme Court rejected a woman IPS officer’s bid to join training after childbirth despite being fit
description: The Supreme Court on Friday declined the plea by IPS probationer Urvashi Sengar to join training at the National police academy after childbirth, despite her claiming to be medically fit.A Bench of Justices Manoj Misra and Shree Chandrashekhar said that while it agreed with Sengar’s challenge to a 1993 Office Memorandum (OM) of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) which mandates a one year hiatus for women trainees after childbirth, it could not permit her to join the ongoing training program
